name: Peet Limited
summary: Peet Limited acquires, develops, and markets residential land in Australia. It operates through the Funds Management, Company-Owned Projects, and Joint Arrangements segments. The company provides underwriting, capital raising, and asset identification services; acquires parcels of land primarily for residential development purposes, as well as produces non-residential blocks of land; and undertakes the development of land through joint arrangements with government, statutory authorities, and private landowners. Peet Limited was founded in 1895 and is based in Perth, Australia.
